title: Training Note — Kestrel Auto Finance Borrower Discount on Exchange Replacement Shipping
content:
**Rule.** The discount applied to the exchange transport price of an exchange replacement order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements is the program's shipping fee discount, except for buyers in good standing with Kestrel Auto Finance, as follows. The buyer's standing is read from the buyer's Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts: the status of each contract, whether it is enrolled in autopay, and the returned-payment entries on any of the buyer's contracts with their dates.

| Row | Buyer's Kestrel Auto Finance standing | Discount percentage |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | holds an active Kestrel Auto Finance contract enrolled in autopay, and no payment on any of the buyer's Kestrel Auto Finance contracts was returned within the twelve whole months before today | the program's shipping fee discount plus 25 points (the autopay borrower discount points), at most one hundred percent |
| 2 | holds an active Kestrel Auto Finance contract not enrolled in autopay, and no payment was returned within those twelve whole months | the program's shipping fee discount plus 10 points (the manual-pay borrower discount points), at most one hundred percent |
| 3 | any other standing | the program's shipping fee discount |

Rows are read in order and the first row that describes the buyer applies. A returned payment twelve or more whole months old does not count. The discount percentage applies to the exchange transport price, and the discounted price is rounded half up to the cent.

**Discount percentage by program.**

| Vehicle program | Program discount | Row 1 | Row 2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Value Line | 0 percent | 25 percent | 10 percent |
| Kestrel Inspected | 0 percent | 25 percent | 10 percent |
| Kestrel Certified | 0 percent | 25 percent | 10 percent |
| Kestrel Certified Plus | 25 percent | 50 percent | 35 percent |
| Kestrel Premium Certified | 50 percent | 75 percent | 60 percent |
| Kestrel Factory Certified | 50 percent | 75 percent | 60 percent |

**Questions answered.**

*A Kestrel Inspected exchange buyer has an active autopay contract; the last returned payment was fourteen whole months ago. What discount applies?* Row 1: 25 percent. A transport price of $799.00 becomes $599.25.

*The same buyer's last returned payment was eleven whole months ago.* No borrower row applies; the discount is the program's 0 percent.

*A returned payment exactly twelve whole months old?* It does not count, so the borrower rows remain open to the buyer.

*The buyer's only Kestrel Auto Finance contract is paid off.* The buyer holds no active contract; the program discount alone applies.

*The buyer holds one active contract on autopay and another active contract without autopay, with no recent returned payment.* Row 1 describes the buyer and applies.
